verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum SSR framework. An official hosting/deploy platform with a public status page is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes self-run Axum servers, CDN cache headers and FFI embedding, and shows no official hosting platform, status page or incident history.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public status page and incident history for the framework's official hosting/deploy platform before relying on it in production
